# Xerographer Fonts

Independent type foundry by Max Infeld. 1,376 original typefaces.
Downloads (aggregated): DaFont + FontSpace + WebFontFree. Individual pages also on BlogFonts, Hey Fonts, FFonts, Fonts2u, FontGet, WhatFontIs, and 1001 Free Fonts.

## For people
- Browse and filter the catalog, or type custom text to test faces.
- Personal use is donationware from DaFont.
- About the designer: https://maxi.grok.me
- Curio Cards: https://curio.cards
- DaFont: https://www.dafont.com/max-infeld.d3584
- Font files on GitHub: https://github.com/maximusmaximus/xerographer-fonts
- FontSpace: https://www.fontspace.com/xerographer-fonts
- BlogFonts: https://blogfonts.com/user/424.htm
- WebFontFree: https://www.webfontfree.com/en/designers/859
- Hey Fonts: https://www.heyfonts.com/designer/max-infeld-xerographer-fonts/
- FFonts: https://www.ffonts.net/tag/infeld
- Fonts2u: per-face pages on every typeface
- FontGet: per-face pages on every typeface
- WhatFontIs: per-face pages on every typeface
- 1001 Free Fonts: https://www.1001freefonts.com/designer-xerographer-fonts-fontlisting.php

## For agents
MCP endpoint: /api/mcp
Discovery: /.well-known/mcp.json

Tools:
- list_fonts, get_font, list_categories, preview_text
- purchase_commercial_license (x402, US$95 USDC, unlimited commercial use, per font per agent)
- purchase_catalog_license (x402, US$65,000 USDC, unlimited commercial use of the entire catalog, one agent)
- get_license

get_font returns per-host listing URLs and download counts (DaFont, FontSpace, BlogFonts, WebFontFree, Hey Fonts, FFonts, Fonts2u, FontGet, WhatFontIs, 1001 Free Fonts).

Payment: HTTP 402 with PAYMENT-REQUIRED. Retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE.
Receipt: PAYMENT-RESPONSE plus PDF at /api/licenses/:id/pdf
Optional `email` on purchase sends the PDF; maxinfeld@gmail.com always receives a copy.

Terms: the licensee may use the licensed typeface(s) commercially in their own work. They may not resell, redistribute, or sublicense the font files. They may not modify the typefaces or create derivative fonts without written permission from Max Infeld / Xerographer Fonts. One licensee (one agent / wallet). A catalog grant covers every face for that licensee.
